items.title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
items.summary: Jensen Huang comes back, numbers go up. Maybe the reason behind the CEO’s return is just that simple?

items.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: The company’s board of directors has reinstated Huang a little more than a week after the CEO resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report.
items.author: Caroline Haskins

items.title: Nvidia Is Powering Brain-Computer Interfaces Now
items.summary: Brain-computer interface company Paradromics is using Nvidia’s computing hardware and software to process brain data.
items.author: Emily Mullin

items.title: Submit Your Questions: Will Anyone Keep You Safe From AI?
items.summary: Experts agree that AI, in one way or another, poses real danger. Will the industry do anything about it? Join our livestream on December 2 to hear your questions answered.

items.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes
items.summary: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk’s companies, alleging they implemented weak safeguards against sexualized imagery of real people, including children.
